ohtani.title: Ha-Seong Kim walks it off in Braves' win
ohtani.blurb: Ha-Seong Kim walks it off with a single and Matt Olson hits a home run in the Braves' 6-5 win over the Dodgers

imanaga.title: Craig Counsell recaps the Cubs' 19-2 win
imanaga.blurb: Craig Counsell talks about the Cubs drawing nine walks, Aaron Civale's performance out of the bullpen and more following the Cubs' 19-2 win

suzuki.title: Eduardo Rodriguez deals in D-backs' shutout 2-0 win
suzuki.blurb: Eduardo Rodriguez deals seven scoreless innings with nine strikeouts and Jordan Lawlar homers to power the D-backs' 2-0 victory over the Cubs

yoshida.title: Sonny Gray, Wilyer Abreu shine in 4-0 shutout win
yoshida.blurb: Seven innings of shutout ball from Sonny Gray and Wilyer Abreu's 22nd homer of the year lead the Red Sox to a 4-0 win over the Pirates

okamoto.title: Lukes and Blue Jays' bullpen fuel 3-0 shutout win
okamoto.blurb: Nathan Lukes crushes a three-run home run and the Blue Jays' bullpen blanks the Royals in Toronto's 3-0 win

murakami.title: Peters, Doyle highlight White Sox 10-4 victory
murakami.blurb: Tristan Peters homers in his fifth straight game and Brenton Doyle lifts a three-run home run in the White Sox 10-4 win over the Rangers

matsui.title: Merrill, Vásquez lead Padres to 3-0 shutout win
matsui.blurb: A two-RBI day from Jackson Merrill and five innings of one-hit ball from Randy Vásquez lead the Padres to a 3-0 win over the Pirates
